decisions.statement: A refusal a mortal page already drew is no refusal the change leaves.
A refusal a change draws anew over a mortal page refuses that change.
A refusal over a page that is not mortal refuses the change however old that refusal is.
A file is mortal where the page type its own name says is mortal.
What a page already drew is read by running the check again over the bodies before the change.
A check drawing no refusal over a mortal page runs once.
The bodies before the change are a change of their own that moves nothing.
A page the change writes anew has no body before it, so that page drew nothing.

definition: the refusals a change draws over a mortal page, less the ones already drawn there
